page_title: TTS voice announcer configuration and use
page_content:
[TOC]

### Installation list
| Name | Quantity | Name | Quantity |
| ------------ | ------------ |------------ | ------------ |
| MDVR device | 1 | MDVR 232 IO harness | 1 |
| Remote control | 1 | Display | 1 |
| TTS voice announcer | 1 | Common wiring tools | n |

### Necessary instructions
- Take **MX-TTS-01-01 (hd)** as an example. **Note: This TTS is 5V. Please do not connect it to 12V power supply, otherwise it will burn out. When the IO expansion cable of the model used does not have 5V, please connect a 5V power supply separately**
- Generally, the MDVR 232 IO harness will be shipped with a plug directly plugged into the TTS female head. If there is no need to find a 5V power supply and 232 serial port for the device, please contact our technical staff for help.

**Actual image**:
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=47727dab69673ce2be883d49c83e03f0)
MX-TTS-01-01

### Operation steps
#### 1. Wiring
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=ab9e55f2ed9998a4cce93b845db86be9)

#### 2. Device menu configuration
Remote control to enter menu>>Settings>>Serial port settings>>Serial port, serial port index configuration RS232, serial port function TTS, baud rate 4800, other parameters default, confirm to save and restart the device to take effect.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=94cd29af7cd03f6e54016d7933a20dc9)

#### 3. Test
3.1 Log in to the platform, click Edit in the platform vehicle information menu and check to enable the TTS function
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=a8902bf4de1472604726f642c7e5d256)

3.2 Click Online Vehicle Selection to send text information to test the TTS broadcast function. After the release is successful, a dialog box will pop up on the device display and a voice prompt will be broadcast.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=417b56c133e14b191b15650ad2b7f85e)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=49200a2b196bba7848d3357a57a299a9)
